css_anchor='  @media (max-width:900px) {\n'
css='''  .purchase-box { border:1px solid var(--panel-line); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; background:#FAFAF8; margin-bottom:14px; }

  .purchase-form input, .purchase-form select { width:100%; margin:0; }
  .purchase-form label { margin-bottom:5px; }
  .purchase-scroll table { min-width:980px; }
  .purchase-note { margin:9px 0 14px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.45; }
  @media (max-width:1100px) { .purchase-form { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width:700px) { .purchase-form { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
'''
assert css_anchor in s
s=s.replace(css_anchor,css+css_anchor,1)
